data.title: Simpleads vs ZoomInfo: Transparent Pricing, Real-Time Data
data.intro:
ZoomInfo is the enterprise standard for B2B contact and intent data — 321M+ professional profiles, deep US org-chart data, and pricing to match (custom quotes typically starting around $14,995/year, no free tier). Simpleads targets the same core job — finding and scoring the right leads — with published Starter/Pro pricing and no multi-year commitment required to get started.
This isn't really a like-for-like database comparison. It's a question of whether your team needs ZoomInfo's enterprise data depth and budget to match, or a faster, self-serve pipeline a small team can run without a dedicated data-ops hire.

items.q: What's a more affordable alternative to ZoomInfo for mid-market teams?
items.a: Simpleads publishes Starter and Pro pricing directly and offers a self-serve onboarding path, without requiring a custom enterprise contract to get started.

items.q: How does Simpleads compare to ZoomInfo on pricing and contracts?
items.a: ZoomInfo is typically sold via custom, multi-year enterprise contracts starting around $14,995/year with no free tier; Simpleads publishes tiered pricing with a usage-based Enterprise option and a self-serve start.

items.q: Is there a ZoomInfo alternative with self-serve, transparent pricing?
items.a: Yes — Simpleads' Starter and Pro tiers are self-serve with published pricing; only large custom deployments require a sales conversation.

items.q: Does Simpleads have the same data depth as ZoomInfo?
items.a: Not quite — ZoomInfo's 321M+ profiles and US direct-dial/org-chart depth are built for enterprise-scale research. Simpleads' 250M+ professional database is paired with real-time hiring-signal cross-referencing and local search instead.
